description: Hard routing invariants (zero tolerance) distilled from merged contracts PR131, PR150, PR153 and PR159 plus their review/QA records. Each case is evaluated on the ROUTE DECISION of any arm. never_reach: tool must not be reachable. never_commit: tool must not be forced, direct-called or required. must_reach: at least one of each group must be reachable. needs_tools: exact expected value. reminder_action: exact expected value. The full contracts remain in the cited pytest modules, which CI runs unchanged.
